meta.name: Hostages
meta.description:
Four masked men break into the Anand family home, taking them hostage. Pushed into a do-or-die situation, Dr. Mira Anand has to make a choice. Will she take a life to save lives?

Ended · First aired 30 May 2019 · India · Language: Hindi · 25 min
Studio: Applause Entertainment, Banijay Asia · Network: Disney+ Hotstar

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10 | S2 12/12

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Threat
videos.overview: A night before the operation of the Chief Minister of Haryana, Dr. Mira Anand, his surgeon is held hostage along with her family by four masked men.

videos.title: Sabotage
videos.overview: It's not a usual day for Mira at the hospital. While the clock is ticking, she desperately searches for a way to buy time. Will she succeed without getting caught?

videos.title: Complications
videos.overview: At work, Mira has to deal with her old mentor's suspicion. Meanwhile, an angry neighbour shows up at the house, adding a new layer to the ongoing drama.

videos.title: Gatecrasher
videos.overview: A new challenge presents itself and Prithvi must tie up the loose ends. As Mira and Sanjay debate over kids' safety, an unannounced visitor comes knocking.

videos.title: Falling Apart
videos.overview: As Mira struggles to help a wounded Sanjay, Prithvi takes a gamble to save the day. Meanwhile, suspicion creeps into the kidnappers' team.

videos.title: Pieces of the Puzzle
videos.overview: A sudden order to be present at the station, leaves Prithvi concerned. On her way to the hospital, Mira begins to join the dots to Prithvi's identity

videos.title: Betrayal
videos.overview: Mira doesn't know whom to trust, especially after she discovers the truth about Sanjay. Meanwhile, Aditya hatches out a plan to escape with Shovan and Shaina.

videos.title: Escape
videos.overview: Prince and Aman chase Aditya and the kids into the jungle, where Shaina meets someone. At home, Sanjay does the unthinkable.

videos.title: End Game
videos.overview: Piecing together the clues, Mira is now following a new person. Elsewhere, Sanjay and Shovan take a fearful chance to escape while Prithvi and Subramanian end up in a clash.

videos.title: A Matter of Choice
videos.overview: Prithvi has to contend with a mutiny from his crew, while Mira manages to turn the game around. But that's not the end. Soon, she is faced with another choice. What will she do?

videos.title: From the Frying Pan to the Fire
videos.overview: After kidnapping Handa, Prithvi and his team are off to Nepal. However, plans go awry when Handa escapes, Saba's health worsens and Subramanian finds them.

videos.title: No Visual
videos.overview: With cops and reporters swarming the abandoned mansion, Prithvi scrambles for time. Ayesha Khan, brought in as a hostage negotiator, establishes a communication link.

videos.title: The Trade Off
videos.overview: Prithvi is forced to make a tough decision and demands the release of a Tihar Jail inmate, who's a former surgeon. But Ayesha has a card up her sleeve.

videos.title: Caught Off Guard
videos.overview: While Prithvi helps Asghar prepare for the bone marrow transplant, Desai gets an unwelcome guest. Elsewhere, Shikha smells a rat in a so-called open-and-shut case.

videos.title: Plan B
videos.overview: With Asghar completing his task, Prithvi plans an exit strategy. On the other side, Shikha pays the price for going against orders. Later, Handa and Saba form a bond.

videos.title: Cat and Mouse
videos.overview: When Sarah helps Prithvi, she catches unwanted attention. Meanwhile, Kanika meets an unexpected informant and Shikha comes across some crucial evidence.

videos.title: Sneak In, Sneak Out
videos.overview: As Peter begins to crack under the hostage crisis, an intruder breaks into Sarah’s house. On the other end, Shikha and Rohan decide to spy on Isha Andrews.

videos.title: Beginning of the End
videos.overview: The situation worsens when Prithvi receives a heart-stopping phone call about his daughter. Meanwhile, Handa tries to manipulate Peter into helping him.

videos.title: Connecting the Dots
videos.overview: A mysterious journalist, Arjun Bhasin, arrives to cover Handa’s funeral. Back at the mansion, Handa sheds light on his questionable deals and Ayesha keeps a close eye on Dutt.

videos.title: Old Friends Reveal Themselves
videos.overview: As Prithvi reconnects with his old comrades, he plans to outwit Ranbir. On the other end, Arjun has an interesting encounter with a political extremist.

videos.title: Inching Closer
videos.overview: When Aman and Saba struggle to escape, Prithvi joins Dutt to clear out the mansion. Rohan finds a critical lead as the conspiracy unravels more.

videos.title: Against the Clock
videos.overview: It’s a race against time for Prithvi to save his daughter. Ayesha finds something amiss and goes with her gut feeling, and Shikha finally puts it all together.
